notes.title: Patch 1.2
notes.content:
We're excited to roll out our next patch, featuring V-Sync, new graphics settings, and improved UX elements. Here's what’s new in this build:

1️⃣No PCs in outer space 
We've added V-Sync, a frame limiter, and resolution settings to help reduce CPU load and overheating. While some issues remain, we're actively working on a full fix.
2️⃣What's up with this wreath? 
We've introduced more hints to guide you smoothly toward the game's finale.
3️⃣What did I miss? 
Probably the puzzle clues! We've added extra guidelines to help with in-game puzzles.


⏳ Update schedule change 
Future patches won’t be as frequent as the last two, as we're temporarily freezing work on Chapter 1 to focus on Chapter 2. Stay tuned on Discord for sneak peeks, screenshots, and developer insights! Please wishlist our game on our main page!

Thanks for your support, and happy gaming!

notes.title: 100+ Prologue Reviews
notes.content:
Thank you for playing The August Before: Chapter 1!

We can't express how grateful we are for your time, reviews, and feedback. We are an indie studio, and this means a world to us — the patches will keep coming and we will keep fixing everything that can cause frustration or your PC to fly to outer space (certified UE5 moment)

In the next patch on Monday, 17.03, you will see: 

 Graphics options: V-Sync, frame limiter, and resolution settings;
bug fixes;
UX improvements: Some players have trouble figuring out how to complete the game, and we've added some things to guide them.


I also want to assure you, that this is just a Chapter 1; plenty of content awaits you in the future. We've talked about it on our Discord server. It could be cool to see you there 

Don't forget to wishlist our main page!!

See you soon!
